summary: VTEX (NYSE: VTEX) filed a Form 6-K announcing the results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders held on May 26, 2026. Shareholders ratified the financial statements for FY 2025 and appointed PricewaterhouseCoopers Auditores Independentes Ltda. as independent auditor for FY 2026. Approximately 96.82% of voting power was represented. This is a routine AGM outcome filing with no special situation event. No deal terms or special corporate actions are present.
